extracted.intended_audience: journalists, partners, community members, and staff writing about or representing Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka
extracted.subtask_description: Brand and editorial guidelines for writing about, referencing, or aligning with Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka, intended to ensure consistent naming, capitalization, acronym use, and visual identity in press and external communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media inquiries contact
rubrics_metrics.description: For all media inquiries, please contact us at info@bgctopeka.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All media or press-related questions should be directed to this address; use it as the primary contact in press materials and media requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use plural 'Club(s)' in organizational name
rubrics_metrics.description: We are comprised of three clubs and eleven in-school units. The word "Club" should be plural.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct: Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka. Incorrect: Boys & Girls Club of Topeka. Always use 'Clubs' (plural) when writing the organization's name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not precede organizational name with 'the'
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not precede our organizational name with “the.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct example: "Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka is dedicated to empowering youth." Incorrect: "The Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka are dedicated to empowering youth." (Avoid leading 'the' and follow recommended capitalization/number agreement.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ampersand (&) in the organization name
rubrics_metrics.description: Always use the ampersand (&) in the name of our organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct: Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka. Incorrect: Boys and Girls Clubs of Topeka. Always use '&' rather than spelling out 'and' when referring to the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalize 'Club' or 'Clubs' when used
rubrics_metrics.description: Club / Clubs – Always capitalize Club(s), in both the phrase Boys & Girls Club(s) and when using it alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When referring to the organization or to an individual Club, capitalize the word 'Club' or 'Clubs' (e.g., 'the Club offers programs').

rubrics_metrics.name: Use 'The Boys & Girls Club Movement' correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: The Boys & Girls Club Movement — Refers to BGCA and Clubs collectively. Club is singular. Movement is capitalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this exact phrasing when referring to the collective movement (BGCA and Clubs). Capitalize 'Movement' and use 'Club' in singular form within this phrase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalize 'Club member' but not 'members'
rubrics_metrics.description: Club member – Young people who registered with the Club; “members” is not capitalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Club member' (capital C) when referring to an enrolled young person as a designated role; use lowercase 'members' for generic references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acronym usage and introduction rules (BGCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our acronym is BGCT. When referring to our organization in an article, please begin the article by calling us Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka. In following sentences, you can refer to us as BGCT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce the full name first, then use the acronym BGCT thereafter. Correct acronym form: 'BGCT'. Incorrect: 'bgct' or 'B.G.C.T.' Do not use lowercase or dotted variations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official logos and primary brand colors
rubrics_metrics.description: This page provides ... our official logos and primary brand colors. These resources ensure consistency and accuracy across all communications and help maintain the integrity of Boys & Girls Clubs of Topeka’s brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When producing external communications or press materials, use the organization's official logos and primary brand colors as provided to maintain visual consistency and brand integrity. (Page references 'Primary Logo White, Transparent' for logo usage.)
